scope: Read-only proposal1 source review, no final tests/build/runtime or shared promotion
source_cause_confirmed: Permanent atomic signal handlers outlive the worker that consumes them; retained failure UI waits without a cancellation wake.
findings: Scoped signal-hook iterator uses a pipe and normal reader thread to update cancellation before sending an existing winit user event. It survives through retained failure UI and covers headless launch.
Completed interrupted state exits without repainting or acquiring a GPU drawable. Active worker retains identity-safe child cleanup and suppresses retained failure after completion.
Normal finish closes and joins the pipe reader after run_app returns. Drop closes without joining a native callback. No timer polling, explicit new waiting lock or launcher unsafe code is added.

Four prepared real-signal subprocess tests cover TERM after worker has joined, TERM before completion, closed receiver and no-signal listener shutdown. They use real listener and shared production transition methods but do not establish actual winit/display/lock acceptance.
decision: Approve brokered isolated CPU/compiler gates. Shared promotion waits for exact-source tests, then actual graphical lifecycle/owned-child/lock qualification. No Neo install or game launch authorized by this review.
